newsitem.title: UK: Saville Gordon to buy RIEL, make rights.
newsitem.headline: Saville Gordon to buy RIEL, make rights.

text.p: J. Saville Gordon Plc said on Friday that it has agreed to buy RIEL, which in turn will acquire two property portfolios for 46.34 million stg payable in cash.

RIEL, which is being bought for 605,000 stg, is owned by Saville Gordon's new chief executive Roger Carey and Mr and Mrs James McAllister and its only assets are the property contracts which have been exchanged.
RIEL is buying the property portfolios from Peel Holdings Plc and The Royal London Mutual Insurance Society Ltd.
Saville Gordon plans to finance the purchase of the property portfolios through a five-for-six rights issue at 55p per share to raise 43.6 million stg.
It will then lend RIEL 26 million stg to complete the purchase with the balance coming from new banking facilities.
The rights issues is being underwritten by NatWest Markets Corporate Finance Ltd.
The property investment group's decision to split the role of chairman and chief executive brings Carey onto the board of Saville Gordon as chief executive from today.
The company said that John Saville will continue as executive chairman until April 1998 after which he will continue as chairman in a non-executive capacity.
